landing.title: Add My IHT to your home screen
landing.subtitle: Install the app and open it in one tap, like any other app on your phone.

benefits.fast: Opens full screen in one tap
benefits.offline: Calendar, homework and grades work without internet
benefits.session: You stay signed in for up to 90 days
benefits.push: Install to get notifications about new marks

installed.title: My IHT is installed
installed.text: Open it from your home screen.

ios.title: Install on iPhone or iPad
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in the browser bar
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
ios.step3: Tap Add. My IHT appears on your home screen.
ios.openInSafari: This browser cannot add apps to the home screen. Open this page in Safari and try again.
ios.pushNote: On iPhone, notifications only work once the app is installed.

manual.title: Install from the browser menu
manual.step1: Open the browser menu (the three dots)
manual.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen
manual.step3: Confirm. My IHT appears on your home screen.

desktop.title: Open My IHT on your phone
desktop.scan: Point your phone camera at the code, then add the app to your home screen.
desktop.qrLabel: QR code with the address of the My IHT app

telegram.hint: Prefer Telegram? The My IHT mini app works there with nothing to install.

hub.title: More IHT apps
hub.subtitle: Each app installs on its own: open it and add it to your home screen.

appInstall.title: Install {name}
appInstall.ownAddress: {name} installs from its own address. Tap the button: {name} opens and offers to install itself.

ios.step1: Tap the button above: {name} opens in Safari
ios.step2: Tap the Share button in the browser bar
ios.step3: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
ios.step4: Tap Add. {name} appears on your home screen.

android.step1: Tap the button above: {name} opens in the browser
android.step2: Tap Install in the message that appears
android.step3: No message? Open the browser menu (the three dots) and choose Install app or Add to Home screen

desktop.step1: Click the button above: {name} opens in the browser
desktop.step2: Click Install in the message that appears, or the install icon in the address bar

appInstall.unknown: This app cannot be installed from here.
